summary: Self-check of the 48 prop images (p4-prop). No person or body part appears in any image. Some images have lettering, duplication or scale faults. The auto-retry budget is 0, so every image was kept as generated. The user decides at H2 which ones to re-roll.

findings.issue: Legible 'For the Duchess' copperplate on the FRONT panel; CR-012 allows legible lettering only on whitelisted props.
findings.suggested_fix: re-roll with the address described as 'faint pale ink flourishes, no words'; or art-director whitelists this line

findings.issue: The open page carries legible handwriting 'Rule Forty-two ... is spoken, CR-012'. The prompt's own rule reference leaked into the image. Do not use the open-page panel as a ref until it is re-rolled. The closed panel and scale_ref_01 are clean.
findings.suggested_fix: re-roll with no rule codes or quoted words in the readable-face text of the prompt

findings.issue: Copied the two-view sheet: shows two trumpets and a 'FRONT' label card on the table.
findings.suggested_fix: re-roll the scale image without --ref to the sheet (or with a single-instance sentence)

findings.issue: Copied the two-view sheet: two glass boxes with two cakes (one standing on edge).
Bottle reads decanter-sized (about 2.5x the teacup); card says about 9 cm, a little taller than a teacup.
Watch about twice the width of the teacup mouth (card: a little narrower). The small sub-dial reads as a seconds dial, not a day-of-month dial.
Watch slightly wider than the teacup mouth (card: a little narrower).
Pebbles are visibly smaller than the cakes and than the penny; SUP-009's hidden cut needs matched size and outline.
Thimble as wide as the penny (about 3 cm; card 1.6 cm, child's thimble).
Label is tied round the body of the bottle, not round the neck as the text says (ch001-p15).
The pieces look like broken whole button mushrooms, not rim pieces of the flat-capped field mushroom built in SCN-caterpillar-clearing.
Dark glossy crimson drips down the pail could read as blood (CR-010 caution). A brighter, opaque distemper red would be safer.
The dish rim is engraved with Art Nouveau whiplash ornament; CR-002 says props stay 1862 even in the dream.
Hookah about 1.15x the chair height (card about 1.5x); the hose is shorter than the 3 m on the card.

findings.file: scale_ref_01.png of PROP-golden-key, PROP-white-rabbit-pocket-watch, PROP-drink-me-bottle, PROP-box-of-comfits, PROP-thimble, PROP-pebbles-and-little-cakes, PROP-mushroom
findings.issue: The bronze penny used as a size anchor carries a small relief portrait head, which is part of a real coin design. It is not a person or body part, but it is flagged for the user to judge against the prop no-person rule (the rule bans 'face' in prompts).

requested_action: User decides at H2 which images to re-roll; 06-art/prop re-runs the named props with code/gen_props_p4-prop.py <PROP-ID> (the script regenerates both images of a prop, so a scale-only fix needs a one-line change to skip main_01), after moving the old images into <id>/candidates/.
